title: Missing moeb tool: Read (large tool output)
description: Used Read (Claude Code) to read large start_spec output saved to disk. No moeb equivalent exists for reading harness-saved large tool result files.
proposed_resolution: Run moeb spec to introduce a moeb tool (e.g. read_tool_result) that accepts a saved tool result path and returns it in paginated chunks.

title: Missing moeb tool: ToolSearch (deferred schema loading)
description: ToolSearch called multiple times to load deferred MCP tool schemas. No moeb equivalent exists for deferred schema resolution in the Claude Code environment.
proposed_resolution: Pre-include required tool schemas in start_spec/start_run output, or introduce a schema-preload mechanism.

title: Missing moeb tool: Glob
description: Used Glob (Claude Code) to find patch_file*.rs source files and .signal.json files by glob pattern. No moeb equivalent exists for pattern-based file discovery.
proposed_resolution: Run moeb spec to introduce a glob_files moeb tool covering pattern-based file discovery.
